llm_response.reason: The website mimics Lazada, a known e-commerce platform, but lists an excessive range of products alongside gambling offers ('slot gacor'), uses unrealistic discounts (up to 80% off), and promises large financial returns ('SITUS DANA BOCORAN') targeting psychological weaknesses. Hyperlinks redirect to external URL shorteners rather than real login or payment portals, and contact/privacy info is ambiguous. These fit multiple key scam criteria, including spoofing, urgency, financial gain promises, confusing product offerings, and no legitimate business information.
